discovery: Uhlitz GSE166555; historical author CNA admission, 4477 cells; no new malignancy inference
subtypes: Original cell_type_epi_custom; all labels retained; descriptive donor means require >=20 cells/donor/type and >=3 donors; paired subtype-vs-rest sign tests require >=20 cells each side and >=6 donors
primary: Per donor Spearman correlation of LYPLA1 and each measured gene using log1p(CP10K), including zero cells; then donor-equal median rho
admission: >=50 CNA cells, >=10 LYPLA1-positive cells, >=3 distinct raw LYPLA1 counts per donor; each gene >=10 detected cells and nonconstant normalized rank within donor; >=6 eligible donors for inference
p_value: Exact two-sided sign test of donor rho directions; not a pooled-cell P or a test of median rho magnitude
ci: 2000 donor bootstrap resamples of median rho, percentile 95%; exploratory marginal interval
selection: raw P<0.05, abs(median rho)>=0.1, >=75% donors same direction; no FDR computation or filtering; full tested family retained
sensitivities: partial rank correlation controlling total UMI minus LYPLA1 UMI
partial rank correlation controlling depth and original subtype dummies within donor
positive LYPLA1 cells only, >=30 positive cells/donor; a different conditional question
replication: Lee GSE132465 Tumor Epithelial cells with author CMS1-CMS4 annotation; exact gene symbols; all selected discovery genes plus prespecified focus frozen before reading Lee expression; same correlation thresholds; not a replication of Uhlitz CNA calls or TC states
cross_cancer: read-only existing BRCA material first; no other-cancer matrix modification or implicit malignancy labels
limitations: Nominal discovery across thousands of genes has multiple-testing false positives
CP10K is relative abundance, depth residualization does not remove all technical coupling
Cell cycle and unmeasured states can confound; subtype sensitivity only addresses supplied labels
CNA is RNA-inferred; Lee tumor CMS epithelial context is not identical CNA admission
No causal, enzymatic, metabolic flux or independent patient identity assertion beyond source metadata
